reference.description: validates eegMultitaper's DPSS tapers against scipy.signal.windows.dpss and its full PSD against an independent scipy+numpy non-adaptive multitaper reconstruction (both machine precision), reports the structure correlation vs MNE psd_array_multitaper (~0.99, up to the one-sided factor-of-2) and the mne scale, and the occipital alpha peak + alpha power fraction
